note: Barbarian with a double-headed axe, front view. Hair and beard are head, beard bottom y~418 (sides of the head end y~372 where the fur mantle starts). Fur mantle, tunic, belt (y560-625), kilt, leather side pieces are torso. Left arm (image left) is bent out holding the axe: bare upper arm y490-528 (partly under the mantle), elbow y528 where the olive bracer begins, bracer is forearm to the wrist y590, then the pale fingers gripping the haft (hand y590-648, haft inside the grip stays hand). The axe (upper blade with haft, and lower blade) is equipment, kept off the fingers. Right arm: bare upper arm y486-563 running diagonally down-right, elbow y563 at the dark cuff, cuff and olive bracer are forearm to the wrist y647, dark gauntleted fist y647-762 is hand. The kilt hem at y~737 is the hip; only a thin bare thigh strip y737-750 shows above the boots. Boot cuffs and shafts reach above halfway, so the knee is the boot top y750; ankle at the instep y808. White slivers near the left hand are cloth/highlights the foreground estimate may drop, labelled by convention.
